title: Billing & Webhook Integrity

defects_fixed.declared: An unauthenticated delivery never consumes an event id and never evicts the genuine delivery that owns it.
defects_fixed.observed_before: processed.add(id) ran BEFORE the signature check, so a forged copy that declares its own sequence sorted first, claimed evt_1, and the verified delivery of the same id was then discarded as a duplicate while the entitlement never applied. An unsigned copy of an already-applied id was reported as a plain duplicate, so the signature was never checked and nothing was recorded as invalid.
defects_fixed.fix: Signature authentication is now decided before processed.add(id), and before duplicate classification.

defects_fixed.declared: Every money-moving transition is recorded, not only the request.
defects_fixed.observed_before: InvoiceRefund had no transition observer, so settle/reject/cancel were never audited; InvoiceDispute likewise recorded only file_dispute, so a provider-LOST dispute (charge stands) and a provider-WON dispute (whole collected amount comes back) both left an audit log claiming the dispute was merely opened.
defects_fixed.fix: InvoiceRefund and InvoiceDispute take a transition observer invoked after every successful state change; AccountCenterInvoiceHistory wires it to the audit log as refund_<verdict> and dispute_<verdict>.

attempted_third_fix_reverted.claim: A won dispute plus a settled refund on one invoice returned 32 on a 20 invoice.
attempted_third_fix_reverted.necessity_result: BLOCK_D reverted the clamp and the official suite still reported All tests passed
attempted_third_fix_reverted.conclusion: There is no shipped public surface that distinguishes the old and new implementation; toPublicJson exposes refunds and disputes as separate rows and no returned_total.
attempted_third_fix_reverted.disposition: PRODUCTION FIX REVERTED; reported as an unmet contract item, NOT as a violation and NOT as a silent pass.

unmet_contract_items.declared: The total a chargeback and its refunds return together is reported, not only summed internally.
unmet_contract_items.observed: toPublicJson exposes refunds and disputes as separate rows and no returned_total, so the aggregate cannot be observed or bounded from outside.
